novelty: Exact exhaustive cross-word output projection search; distinct from counter finite differences and prior per-bit ANF families.
scope: controlled reduced ChaCha only; target-free forward-map structural falsifier
projection_class: all 120 unordered word pairs (i,j), 0<=i<j<16, with X_ij(k)=Z_i(k) xor Z_j(k); all 32 bit positions per pair
exact_method: Complete 2^b truth tables and exact packed GF(2) Mobius ANF for all 3840 projected bits. Also compute individual component-word ANF metrics as frozen baseline.
stable_sparse_projection_rule: A projected bit (i,j,bit) is stable-useful iff degree<=6 and support exponent<=0.75 at both b14 and b16 for R6.
component_gain_rule: At b16, for a stable projected bit compare against the better of the two same-position component bits: degree_gain=min(deg_i,deg_j)-deg_proj; support_gain=min(exp_i,exp_j)-exp_proj.
secondary_control: R4 metrics are diagnostic only and cannot rescue R6 failure.
stage1_only_if_pass: Freeze a fresh algebraic-system/TOTAL scaling stage using only preregistered stable projection coordinates. Bill exhaustive projection search as one-time preprocessing plus monomial generation, solve, memory, matching/collisions and exact verification. No alpha claim from Stage0 alone.
kill_rule: If any R6 primary gate fails, close exhaustive cross-word XOR projection family. No modular-sum reinterpretation, pair cherry-picking, threshold changes, output subset or second development set inside this family.
forbidden: No target selection, post-hoc pair selection, approximate ANF, learned projection selection, or full-round claim.
